title: Your tools. Your sources. Your science.
takeaway: Your scientific tools and sources can work together in a program.
proof: A genuine PTC program performs four source reads and produces a concise count summary with source references.
limits: CSC cells are columns; data vector entries are not cells. Displayed program is a condensed excerpt.
hardest: Clear surrounding source/tool cards before the result expands; no idle toolbar.

copy.text: Bring the sources and tools your work needs.
One program handles the reads, checks and calculation.
Keep the useful result—and where it came from.
